parameters.help_en: The ID of the smart tagging job to query. You can obtain the ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能标签作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The additional request parameters, represented as a JSON string. Example: {"labelResultType":"auto"}. The labelResultType parameter is of the String type. Valid values:

auto: machine tagging results

hmi: human-machine collaboration results
parameters.help_zh:
额外的请求参数，使用JSON字符串表示，例如：{"labelResultType":"auto"}。其中，labelResultType为String类型，可取值：

auto：机器打标结果

hmi：人机协同结果
parameters.name: params

JobStatus.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Success: The job is processed successfully.

Fail: The job fails to be processed.

Processing: The job is being processed.

Submitted: The job is submitted and waiting to be processed
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态，可取值：

Success：处理成功。

Fail：处理失败。

Processing：处理中。

Submitted：已提交等待处理

Result.description_en: The array of analysis result objects

Data.description_en: The specific data of the analysis result, represented as a JSON character string. For the data structures of different types, see the Result parameter description below
Data.description_zh: 分析结果的具体数据，以JSON字符串表示。不同Type的数据结构见下文Result参数说明

Type.description_en:
The type of the analysis result.

[ ] - Smart Tagging 1.0 analysis result types:


TextLabel: text tags
VideoLabel: video tags
ASR: original automatic speech recognition (ASR) results (not returned by default)
OCR: original optical character recognition (OCR) results (not returned by default)
NLP: natural language processing (NLP) results (not returned by default)


[ ] - Smart Tagging 2.0 analysis result types:

CPVLabel
Meta: information such as video titles (not returned by default)

[ ] - Smart Tagging 2.0-custom analysis result types:

CPVLabel
Meta: information such as video titles (not returned by default)
Type.description_zh:
分析结果的类型。

[ ] - 标签1.0分析结果类型：


TextLabel：文本标签
VideoLabel：视频标签
ASR：语音识别原始结果（默认不返回）
OCR：文字识别原始结果（默认不返回）
NLP：NLP处理结果（默认不返回）


[ ] - 标签2.0分析结果类型：

CPVLabel
Meta：视频标题等信息（默认不返回）

[ ] - 标签2.0-custom分析结果类型：

CPVLabel
Meta：视频标题等信息（默认不返回）

UserData.description_en: The information passed through during an MNS callback. For the message format, see the callback message format definition below
UserData.description_zh: 通过MNS回调时透传回来的信息。消息格式请参见下文回调消息格式定义
